_readme: HAND-EDITED ALIAS MAP. Checked before every other resolution route, so an entry
here always wins — including over the 'two names in one box scores zero' rule.
Keys are normalized answers: lowercase, no punctuation, no accents, no odds or
'(favorite)' parenthetical, no ', WR, Titans' suffix, no Jr./III. In practice:
type the answer in lowercase with the parentheses removed.
byQuestion  keyed by question id, and beats `global`. Use it when the same
word means different things in different columns.
Anything the resolver could not place shows up on /nfl-futures-26-27/admin with
the exact key to paste here.
